title: Gangs of Gotham #1
desc:
CHRISTOPHER CANTWELL AND MIKE HENDERSON TAKE ON GOTHAM CITY IN THE AFTERMATH OF BATMAN: BAD SEEDS!

Anarky rules!

Anarky has been given an ultimatum by the Torus: Unify the 100 low-level street gangs not currently under Torus control—or die. If Lonnie Machin succeeds, he'll get a seat at the table. But if he fails, it's lights out for Anarky.

His first stop?

Gotham's East End—a complete free-for-all for some of Gotham's nastiest and most uncontrollable individuals. Should be simple enough...right?

Spiraling out of the pages of Batman: Bad Seeds and Batman comes Gangs of Gotham, a thrilling, action-packed, street-level criminal saga from Christopher Cantwell and Mike Henderson!
